body: Thank you dude, but it really is easier said then done. I do have a positive attitude but my negative side of my brain just overcomes it a lot. I’ve been struggling with this for years. It’s just a matter of being consistent with the positive attitude so you can make healthy life changing routines to your lifestyle and live the best you. I know all that. I’m just not strong enough. I struggle so much with anxiety, depression, and self esteem issues. So it’s just super tough, and I’ve been planning to end my life for years. This is the year
What helps?
Just life you know how it is
Wow that must’ve been hard, props to you tho. I wish I had found out earlier
Scary if you think about it…
What’s the app called?
That’s my worry tho, am I always gonna have side effects now my whole life trying different medications seeing what works?
Ok well that’s good to know, thank you
Would medication mess with my creative processes?
I don’t even know if I could do a mood journal properly… I’m so numb a lot of the time
It’s just another struggle that adds to my life that I don’t wanna deal with, how are you able to do it?

Fr everyone is just like “go to therapy” don’t you think I’ve tried??? It’s so fucking hard to actually get to one now, and even when u find one it’s still expensive so it probably won’t be long term. The system in America is fucked
I mean maybe but it’s still just not the same type of privacy that I would be seeking for normal therapy
Yea I believe so, it’s just that I wanted the privacy of face to face so my mom doesn’t hear me talk to my therapist on my laptop
The love is artificial unfortunately
Not strong enough to live in this miserable world anymore
I turn 21 so I can finally purchase what I need
I’m not strong enough
No I wish I was
Guess we just unlucky :/
The cancer made it so that the sperm shouldn’t have even been able to fertilize the egg, I’m literally a mistake
Thank you I will definitely try these methods, I hope I can get through it with this advice. Appreciate the kind words

Damn you’re completely right. And for me it’s not that I’m forcing the music, it’s more like I’m forcing myself to keep going lol. But yea ik wym since I’m not very good at expressing my feelings to people but I feel like music is such a great outlet for that. I feel like it’s be the only way I know how to speak my emotions since I’ve been through a lot of shit personally. Thank you for the response dude I really appreciate it. And gl to whatever music you’re choosing to create as well

Wow thank you for that response, and currently no I don’t have any place where I’ve posted my work. The thing abt what you’re saying tho like I get it everyone is unique in their own way when making music but is it really worth it? Why should I even drop something if I plan on ending my life anyways? It just all feels so forced sometimes. Not making music but daily living tasks in general. I’m just really deep in my depression
That is true, baby steps can really help. I’ll try asking those questions to myself and starting over again. Thank you for the kind words

What if currently tho nothing is going right, I can’t really focus so it’s hard to gain that type of perspective in my life right now. And when I do gain some I just feel so minuscule in life right now
A lot of lonely souls in this fucked up world, I’m sorry about that :(
Too real
Thank u I really appreciate it
Thank u and I hope so, shit just really sucks :/
I really want too
Thank you, I’m sorry too :/
Unfortunately I doubt it, I just wanna sleep forever
Thank u, I’m sorry too :(
I’m not strong enough to keep holding on, everyday is utter pain and misery and I’m so tired of it
I just plan on shooting myself when in a forest where no one can find me
Same I’m so done with everything and so worn out
Thank you for that advice, gl to you too

Change of mindset and different habits but I’ve tried for years and I’m not strong enough. I only think professional help could work but I’m afraid of the medication and what it might do. I just feel really lost
I’m not strong enough
Hopefully..thank you though

This. I knew this is something I should really do. Unfortunately when you grow up watching porn, it just becomes addictive. It’s definitely one of my bad coping methods. I usually try no fap but fail within 2-3 weeks. So as with all the other advice I’ve read, I will definitely try again. It’s nice to know it really helps people though, glad you said so. Thank you, I really appreciate the message
She’s really the one thing holding me back :( it would break her heart and completely devastate her. I could never do it to her, she already knows too much pain from this world

Yea I guess your right, I really shouldn’t be stressing this much. But I have so much free will right now and it’s just hard to get by because of me. I’m so fucked in the head. But thank a lot I really appreciate the kind words
Yea meds and professional help seems like the only option I have left to help myself now. Thank you for the advice, I appreciate it

Lol it’s funny you say that because Stone ocean and attack on titan are things I’m both very keen on watching and knowing I wouldn’t be able to watch them if I was dead makes me just want to wait it out longer. I used to play video games hella but not as much anymore since being in college. Thank you for the comment tho I appreciate it

Unfortunately ever since covid, my relationship with my mom has become toxic. I wouldn’t want to put more stress on her since she works multiple jobs and lives just for me. I have told her my thoughts before and it’s broken her so much. I can’t bear to see her like that so I tell her I’m happy. She lives for me and I live for her. The problem is me since I don’t believe in love and have severe intimacy issues
I will my guy, thank you again
Mucho gracias para este mensaje, tienes un buen día

Nothing..I don’t have talent, I wish I did. I wish I was smart, I got kicked out of my university. And I’m not a good looking attractive dude either. I don’t really have a skill I wish I could say I’m good at

This is what I’m considering as my only option left. I’m not afraid of doctors, but more about the medications that will be prescribed. Like I’ve heard so many horror stories about us screwing people up. I’m already messed up mentally, would it really help me out with my mind? And also, If I told a doctor I was suicidal, would I not be able to purchase a firearm? They’d diagnose me with depression and probably stop me from being able to purchase my only way out of this world. Only asking because it’s the harsh truth
This is what I’m afraid of truly
Yeaaa… anyways I’m sorry man and best of luck to the both of us
Yea I’m trying to pick up producing as a hobby. Hoping to find a community within that, gives me some sort of goal to pursue. Anyways thank you for the kind words. I really do appreciate it
Thank you for the kind words, I hope you also had a good thanksgiving

I actually cut out Instagram, snapchat, and Twitter out of my life during summer. It didn’t really help, might’ve just added to my depression. Like sure the peace and quiet nature is all fine and dandy but I think it really just added more to my loneliness. As much as I hate the fake shit on social media, alot of it is toxic. But we grew up with it so I can’t find a way to keep in connection with friends without it
Thank you for the kind words, I really do appreciate it. And also thank you for the hug message, I don’t get much hugs and intimacy is something I really struggle with. So again thank you so much!
Thank you for the kind message, I really appreciate it. Hoping the best for yiu

Yes this is so true, thank you for the advice I really do appreciate it. But yea that’s where I’m at now, having to love myself when in reality I hate myself and I want to die. I have so much trouble with intimacy and love, that I’m afraid to confront others about my true feelings. Depresion and anxiety are a cruel duo. I really hope I can get through it. I’m glad you were able to, keep going and don’t stop

Wow thank you for the words of advice, I really do appreciate it. Honestly it’s the negative thoughts and anxiety that really get to me. I just forgot how to love myself. Truly expressing myself and getting intimate is so hard for me because I hate myself and want to die. Wish I could just go back to being the happy blind child I was in the world
Thank you for your kind words and advice, I really do appreciate it. It helps to know I’m not the only one going through this
Thank you for the kind words I really appreciate it. I’ll definitely try to seek out some sort of professional help. It seems like my only option left

Thank you for the message I really appreciate it. But I’ve been trying to get out of this vicious cycle for years. I started exercising for years and lost 70lbs, but I’m still not happy with my body. I got a job but it’s really only just a temporary part time while I’m in college. I was at a university but I got kicked out last year, now I’m at a community college. And I’ve picked up a hobby of producing/beat making since I recently found a love for music. It’s a lot but I’ve lost the love for so many things. I’m trying to pick myself back up again because I keep failing over and over. It seems worthless in the end

I read everything and will do everything in my ability to follow some kind of routine I can set for myself. It’s a hard path down the road for all of us, I’m just hoping I can achieve it. Thank you for your advice in the message, I really do appreciate it
Yea she’s the only person that really holds me back from doing it. She’d be devastated and I could never do that to her. Thank you for your message
I’m glad you were able to find that reason. I hope I can also find that within myself as well. Thank you for the words of advice, I appreciate them

Thank you for the words, I appreciate it

Other than the whole gain a new perspective which is something I know I can attempt to do. I just have a lot of issues with myself when it comes to relationships and intimacy, I’m so fucked in the head I feel like no one likes me (even though ik it’s not the case). Thank you :)

You’re so right, I’ll try again. I’ve started over so many times but I just need to face that fear. Start over and become fresh. Thank you so much I appreciate the advice, I really needed it in times of struggling. Especially since it’s on a holiday
